title: 登山的机器狗与倒着飞的蜂鸟
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol26/Vol26_晚读讲义_登山的机器狗与倒着飞的蜂鸟_v1.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we meet two amazing movers. Our first hero has four legs, but it is not a dog. It climbs mountains, wades through icy rivers, and never gets tired. Our second hero is smaller than your thumb, yet it can do something no other bird on Earth can do. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们要认识两位了不起的“行动派”。第一位主角有四条腿，却不是小狗——它能爬山、蹚冰河，还永远不知道累。第二位主角比你的大拇指还小，却会一招全世界独一无二的本事。出发吧！

blocks.en: High on the stone steps of Mount Tai in China, a line of pedestrians stops and stares. Coming up the steps is a robot dog with a heavy bag on its back. These robot dogs work as mountain porters, carrying heavy loads so human porters can rest. One robot dog, called B2-W, can carry forty kilograms and walk fifty kilometres on one charge. Cheers erupt as it arrives at the top.
blocks.title: 登山的机器狗
blocks.cn: 在中国泰山的石阶上，一排步行者停下脚步、瞪大了眼睛。石阶上走来一只机器狗，背上背着沉甸甸的包。这些机器狗是高山挑夫，背着重物上下山，让人类挑夫可以休息。一只名叫 B2-W 的机器狗能背四十公斤、一口气走五十公里。欢呼声在它到达山顶时迸发出来。

blocks.en: Another robot dog, called Lynx, works high on a cold mountain, where the air is thin and it is thirty degrees below zero. It climbs slopes as steep as forty-five degrees, splashes through icy rivers eighty centimetres deep, cold spray flying around its legs, and keeps its balance. Its cameras have sharp discrimination: they can tell a safe rock from a loose one. The robot's patience never runs out: it can try the same steep path again until it finds a safe way up.
blocks.title: 登山的机器狗
blocks.cn: 另一只名叫“山猫”的机器狗，在寒冷的高山上工作，那里空气稀薄、气温低到零下三十度。它能爬上四十五度的陡坡，蹚过八十厘米深的冰河，冰冷的水花飞溅在它的腿边，还能保持平衡。它的摄像头辨别力很强：能分清哪块岩石安全、哪块松动。机器人的耐心永远不会耗尽：同一条陡峭的路，它可以一遍遍试，直到找到安全的上山路线。

blocks.en: They are quick, too. One of them, called HOUND, holds a world record: it ran one hundred metres in less than twenty seconds. They are ambassadors for a new kind of helper. On a mountain, it is a champion.
blocks.title: 登山的机器狗
blocks.cn: 它们还很快呢。其中一只名叫“猎犬”的机器狗保持着一项世界纪录：一百米只跑了不到二十秒。它们是新型帮手的大使。在高山上，它就是冠军。

blocks.en: Now meet a bird with a great trick. The hummingbird is no bigger than your thumb, and it drinks sweet nectar from flowers. Most birds must turn around to leave a flower. Not the hummingbird. It simply flies backwards, straight out of the flower. It is the only bird on Earth that can do this.
blocks.title: 倒着飞的蜂鸟
blocks.cn: 现在认识一只会绝招的小鸟。蜂鸟只有你的大拇指那么大，靠喝花蜜生活。大多数鸟离开花朵时必须转身。蜂鸟不用。它直接倒着飞出花朵。它是全世界唯一能这样做的鸟。

blocks.en: The secret is in its wings. Most birds flap up and down, and only push air on the way down. A hummingbird's wings move in a figure eight — they push air on the way up and on the way down, too. Its wings can beat fifty to eighty times every second. Its shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint, like yours, so its wings can turn in every direction.
blocks.title: 倒着飞的蜂鸟
blocks.cn: 秘密就在它的翅膀里。大多数鸟上下扇动翅膀，只在向下扇时推动空气。蜂鸟的翅膀画出 8 字形——向上扇和向下扇时都能推动空气。它的翅膀每秒能扇动五十到八十次。它的肩膀是像你一样的球窝关节，所以翅膀能朝各个方向转动。

blocks.en: A hummingbird's flight muscles make up nearly one third of its body. It must eat all day, and males even fight over the best flowers. Its throat shines like a diamond in the sun, vivid green and red. When it flies away, its soft hum fades into the garden. Evolution gave this tiny bird a wonderful gift: wings that can carry it forwards, backwards, and even upside down.
blocks.title: 倒着飞的蜂鸟
blocks.cn: 蜂鸟的飞行肌肉占身体将近三分之一。它整天都要吃东西，雄鸟甚至会为最好的花朵打架。它的喉咙在阳光下像钻石一样闪耀，鲜艳的绿色和红色。它飞走时，轻柔的嗡嗡声渐渐消失在花园里。进化给了这只小鸟一份奇妙的礼物：能向前、向后、甚至倒着飞的翅膀。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "keep an eye on." It means to watch something or someone carefully. The engineers keep an eye on the robot dog as it climbs the mountain. Here's an example: "Please keep an eye on my little brother while I buy the tickets." So, keep an eye on things you care about — and keep an eye on the hummingbird, too, or it will zoom away before you blink!
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“keep an eye on”（留心看管）：意思是认真地看着某人或某物。工程师们登山时一直留心看着机器狗。举个例子：“请帮我留心看着弟弟，我去买票。”所以，留心看着你在乎的东西——还有蜂鸟，不然它一眨眼就飞走了！

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. We met robot dogs that climb mountains in freezing cold, and a tiny bird that flies backwards. First: if you had a robot dog, what job would you give it? Second: if you could fly like a hummingbird, where would you fly first — forwards or backwards? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。我们认识了在严寒中爬山的机器狗，和一只倒着飞的小鸟。第一：如果你有一只机器狗，你会让它做什么工作？第二：如果你能像蜂鸟一样飞，你会先往哪儿飞——向前还是向后？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Keep an eye on the little wonders around you — and keep exploring. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。留心观察你身边的奇妙事物——继续探索吧。明天早上见！

questions:

A. On a beach

B. Watch something carefully
C. Look away
D. Cry

Why can a hummingbird fly backwards?
A. Its wings move in a figure eight and push air both ways
B. It is very big
C. It has no feathers
D. It never eats

children.text: its wings can turn in every direction.
：like + 名词或代词，表示“像……一样”。这里的 yours = your shoulder（你的肩膀），用物主代词代替重复的名词，句子更简洁。读到 like，要立刻找它后面比较的对象。
so its wings can turn in every direction
：so + 一个完整的句子，表示前面情况带来的结果——因为肩膀是球窝关节、能灵活转动，所以翅膀才能朝各个方向转。
：ball（球）+ and + socket（窝）用连字符连起来，整体作定语修饰 joint（关节）。turn in every direction = 朝各个方向转动。
结构特点（球窝关节）→ 比较（像你的一样）→ 结果（翅膀朝各个方向转）
。一句话里藏着比较、结果和复合词三个机关。

"move in a figure eight — they push air on the way up and on the way down, too."
